Staffing was founded to fix the most common problem in fleet operations: shifts that don't get covered.

Rental car centers, parking operators and logistics yards depend on hourly teams. When a driver or porter doesn't show, cars don't move and customers wait. We started Staffing to give these operations a partner that **owns the outcome** — not just a list of names.

## Our Commitment

- **Our own employees.** Every worker is our own W-2 employee — insured, trained and accountable to us.
- **Supervision included.** A dedicated supervisor leads every site.
- **Transparency.** Attendance and hours are tracked in real time and shared with you.
- **Local first.** We recruit, train and operate in metro Atlanta."}}]}, {"node": "flabout_009", "element": "col", "data": {"label": "StoryImg", "animation": "fade-left"}, "elements": [{"node":
